reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: corsOptions is live code actively used at src/index.ts:34 (app.use(cors(corsOptions))). Gate 2: attack vector originates from external untrusted browser/web clients — no trust_assumptions entry suppresses this. Gate 3: src/index.ts CORS config is explicitly in scope and 'CORS wildcard default if ALLOWED_ORIGINS unset' is listed as a key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via cross-origin requests by hosting a malicious web page, causing credentialed API responses to be readable cross-origin and exposing guild/bot metadata to any origin when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is not configured.
